text:
Anya: Pasted profiler traces from the Mistral+FP8 run I mentioned. Not pretty: p50 is fine but p99 spikes 2.4x after calibration. I think we hit a kernel fallback on the attention matmul for certain heads. Logs + sample perf table below.

Raj: Can you drop the short summary numbers? also which build/commit? :eyes:

Anya: Build r-2026.03.12. Summary: 512-token context, batch 4 -> baseline INT8 run p50 120ms p99 210ms throughput 850 tok/s. After FP8 calib profile A: p50 140ms p99 520ms throughput 430 tok/s.

Maria: That p99 jump implies a slow path for some sequences. Did KV cache behavior change?

Anya: Yes — memory allocator logs show extra reallocs when KV pages cross 256MB boundaries. Looks correlated with per-channel quant offsets increasing memory fragmentation.

Tomas: Do you have the kernel selector trace? my guess is we fell back from fused GEMM to a reference matmul for small head dims due to quant params not meeting alignment constraints.

Anya: Pasted the selector snippet from the trace: 
```
kernel_selector: try fgemm_q4f -> fail(align=16) -> try int8_gemm_q8 -> ok(but slow path)
registers: head_dim=96, seq_len=512, quant_mode=per_channel, zero_point_nonzero=true
```

Leo: Per-channel FP8 with nonzero zpoint is expensive: scatter/gather introduced and disables vectorized path. If calibration produced nonzero zpoints for many layers that explains regression.

Olivia: How was the calibration dataset sampled? small vocab skew can bias zpoints. We should try symmetric per-tensor clipping as a control.

Anya: Calib set = 500 short dialogs (avg 40 tokens) sampled from prod shard A. Probably too short for KV stat capture.

Raj: Actionable experiments: (1) rerun calib with 5k sequences including long contexts, (2) force per-tensor FP8 for attention kernels only, (3) tweak allocator threshold from 256MB -> 512MB to avoid thrash. I can spin these up.

Tomas: Also add a quick kernel-selector patch to prefer int8_fused_gemm when head_dim==96 and seq>128 unless per-channel zpoint nonzero. Should be safe as fallback.

Maria: Can we get a microbenchmark of the scatter overhead? if it's <5% maybe keep per-channel. If >30% we should prefer per-tensor by default for small heads.

infra-bot: Started cluster run: job perf-fp8-calib-1814000000 on pool gpu-labs-8. ETA 12m.

Leo: I'll prepare a candidate quant profile file and upload to the shared bucket: /quant_profiles/mistral_fp8_hybrid_expt_v3.json. It will set attention to per-tensor symmetric and ffns to per-channel.

Olivia: Also add a note to docs about representative calib sets: include long-tail tokens and a mix of batch sizes; short-dialog-only leads to harmful zpoints.

Anya: Thanks all. I'll post results when infra finishes. If perf improves we'll prod a kernel selector change + new default profile for Mistral variants. :thumbsup:
